in_sanskrit.name: Avula
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Avulomba
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Avula एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Avulomba is an alternate name for the Hindu goddess Durga. Avula is derived from this name and means 'Goddess Avulomba'.

in_tamil.name: Avula
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Goddess Avulomba
in_tamil.long_meaning: Avula ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Avulomba is an alternate name for the Hindu goddess Durga. Avula is derived from this name and means 'Goddess Avulomba'.

in_telugu.name: అవుల
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Avula is derived from the Telugu word 'avu', which means 'banyan tree'. The banyan tree is a large, powerful, and long-lived tree that provides shelter and sustenance to many creatures. It is a symbol of strength, stability, and continuity, and is revered in Indian culture.
